stem.text: In plants adapted to cold conditions, their cell surface membranes change as the weather gets colder, allowing the plants to carry out exocytosis.
Which change occurs in their cell surface membranes?

A.text: a decrease in the ratio of proteins to saturated phospholipids

B.text: a decrease in the ratio of unsaturated phospholipids to saturated phospholipids

C.text: an increase in the ratio of proteins to unsaturated phospholipids

D.text: an increase in the ratio of unsaturated phospholipids to saturated phospholipids
